t: Gir Forest in Gujarat is the only place in the world where Asiatic lions live in the wild.
The Statue of Unity in Gujarat stands 182 metres tall — the tallest statue in the world.
Ahmedabad became India's first UNESCO World Heritage City in 2017.
Rani ki Vav, the stepwell at Patan in Gujarat, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and appears on the ₹100 note.
Dholavira in Kutch is one of the largest cities of the Harappan civilisation, over 4,500 years old.
The Great Rann of Kutch is one of the largest salt deserts on Earth.
On 23 August 2023, Chandrayaan-3 made India the first country to land near the Moon's south pole.
The Kailasa temple at Ellora was carved top-down out of a single rock, more than 1,200 years ago.
Brahmagupta wrote down rules for calculating with zero in 628 CE.
Chess grew out of chaturanga, a game played in India around the 6th century.
Mawsynram in Meghalaya is one of the wettest places on Earth.
The Ganges river dolphin is India's national aquatic animal. It is almost blind and finds its way with sound.
Indian Railways is one of the world's largest employers, with over a million staff.
Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
A day on Venus is longer than its year: it spins once every 243 Earth days but orbits the Sun in 225.
Botanically, bananas are berries — and strawberries are not.
Sunlight takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth.
Tigers have striped skin, not just striped fur.
Elephants can recognise themselves in a mirror — a sign of self-awareness.
Sound travels about four times faster in water than in air.
Our galaxy, the Milky Way, holds an estimated 100 to 400 billion stars.
A teaspoon of neutron-star material would weigh around a billion tonnes.
Hummingbirds can fly backwards.
The Eiffel Tower grows up to about 15 cm taller in summer as its iron expands in the heat.
Honey found in ancient Egyptian tombs, thousands of years old, was still edible.
Your body carries roughly as many bacterial cells as human cells.
Earth's days are slowly getting longer — by about 1.7 milliseconds every century.
Peacocks' tail 'eyes' are made by microscopic structures that bend light, not by pigment.
The Western Ghats are older than the Himalayas and are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Light from the Andromeda galaxy, visible on a dark night, set off about 2.5 million years ago.
Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high…
You have a right to your actions, but never to the fruits of your actions.
Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will.
Imagination is more important than knowledge.
The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
Not all those who wander are lost.
That's one small step for a man, one giant leap for mankind.
Look up at the stars and not down at your feet.
वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम्
m: The whole world is one family.

t: सत्यमेव जयते
योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्
उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः
m: Work is achieved by effort, not by mere wishes.

t:
काल करे सो आज कर, आज करे सो अब।
पल में परलय होएगी, बहुरि करेगा कब॥
m: Do tomorrow's work today, and today's work now. The moment may pass — when will you do it then?

t:
धीरे-धीरे रे मना, धीरे सब कुछ होय।
माली सींचे सौ घड़ा, ऋतु आए फल होय॥
m: Patience, mind — all things happen in time. The gardener may pour a hundred pots, but fruit comes only in its season.

t:
बुरा जो देखन मैं चला, बुरा न मिलिया कोय।
जो दिल खोजा आपना, मुझसे बुरा न कोय॥
m: I went looking for the bad in others and found none; when I searched my own heart, I found no one worse than me.

t:
रहिमन धागा प्रेम का, मत तोड़ो चटकाय।
टूटे से फिर ना मिले, मिले गाँठ पड़ जाय॥
m: Don't snap the thread of love — once broken it won't rejoin, and if it does, a knot remains.

t: करत-करत अभ्यास के, जड़मति होत सुजान।
m: With constant practice, even a dull mind becomes wise.

t: जहाँ चाह, वहाँ राह।
m: Where there's a will, there's a way.

t: बूँद-बूँद से घड़ा भरता है।
m: Drop by drop, the pot fills.

t: अधजल गगरी छलकत जाय।
m: A half-filled pot spills the most — shallow people show off.

t: વૈષ્ણવ જન તો તેને કહીએ, જે પીડ પરાઈ જાણે રે।
m: Call them truly good who feel the pain of others.

t: ટીપે ટીપે સરોવર ભરાય.
m: Drop by drop, a lake fills.

t: જેવું વાવો તેવું લણો.
m: As you sow, so shall you reap.

t: મન હોય તો માળવે જવાય.
m: If the heart is willing, even far-off Malwa can be reached.

t: સંપ ત્યાં જંપ.
m: Where there is unity, there is peace.

t: બોલે તેના બોર વેચાય.
m: Those who speak up sell their berries — speak up to get ahead.

t: ઉતાવળા સો બાવરા, ધીરા સો ગંભીર.
m: The hasty get flustered; the patient stay composed.
